decisions.reason: As a more peripheral consumer product with limited visible commitment compared with the firm's core industrial technology lines, it is more likely to fall below aspiration levels and be cut so resources can be redirected despite some organizational slack.

Because this modular extension line fits the established waste-to-energy business and can leverage existing capabilities and customers, its performance is more likely to be seen as satisfactory enough to retain under the firm's current growth and hiring conditions.

As a flagship product with its own page and explicit launch emphasis in the firm's strategic direction, management is likely to judge it against longer-term aspirations and continue supporting it unless results clearly disappoint.

This product is close to the firm's established offer and was presented as a focus area, so with industry growth and some slack the firm is likely to keep it on the market while learning about its commercial potential.
